$comment: SQLite metric queries that db-copy rewrites to their Postgres form, matched on the exact SQL and params of a widget query or a variable options query: the starter dashboard (migration 092, Postgres form in 370) and the new-dashboard template of the UI before it became portable. Any other title, layout or query stays as the operator saved it.

sqlite.sql: SELECT date(createdAt) AS day, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

postgres.sql: SELECT to_char("createdAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE "createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

sqlite.sql: SELECT COALESCE(u.name, 'Unassigned') AS user, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS tasks, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sc.totalCostUsd), 0), 4) AS cost_usd FROM agent_tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.requestedByUserId LEFT JOIN session_costs sc ON sc.taskId = t.id WHERE t.createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR COALESCE(u.id, '') = ? OR COALESCE(u.name, '') LIKE '%' || ? || '%') AND (? = 'all' OR COALESCE(t.agentId, '') = ?) GROUP BY COALESCE(u.name, 'Unassigned') ORDER BY cost_usd DESC, tasks DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT COALESCE(u.name, 'Unassigned') AS "user", COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) AS tasks, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(sc."totalCostUsd"), 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS cost_usd FROM agent_tasks t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t."requestedByUserId" LEFT JOIN session_costs sc ON sc."taskId" = t.id WHERE t."createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE(u.id, '') = $2 OR COALESCE(u.name, '') LIKE '%' || $2 || '%') AND ($3 = 'all' OR COALESCE(t."agentId", '') = $3) GROUP BY COALESCE(u.name, 'Unassigned') ORDER BY cost_usd DESC, tasks DESC

sqlite.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(DISTINCT taskId) AS tasks, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM(inputTokens + outputTokens) AS tokens, ROUND(SUM(totalCostUsd), 2) AS cost_usd FROM session_costs WHERE createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR agentId = ?) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(DISTINCT "taskId") AS tasks, COUNT(*) AS sessions, SUM("inputTokens" + "outputTokens")::bigint AS tokens, ROUND((SUM("totalCostUsd"))::numeric, 2)::float8 AS cost_usd FROM session_costs WHERE "createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE("agentId", '') = $2) GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_usd DESC NULLS LAST

sqlite.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(DISTINCT taskId) AS tasks, ROUND(SUM(totalCostUsd) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT taskId), 0), 4) AS avg_cost_per_task FROM session_costs WHERE createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR agentId = ?) GROUP BY model ORDER BY avg_cost_per_task DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(DISTINCT "taskId") AS tasks, ROUND((SUM("totalCostUsd") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "taskId"), 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS avg_cost_per_task FROM session_costs WHERE "createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE("agentId", '') = $2) GROUP BY model ORDER BY avg_cost_per_task DESC NULLS LAST

sqlite.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS tasks, ROUND(AVG((julianday(finishedAt) - julianday(createdAt)) * 1440), 1) AS avg_minutes FROM agent_tasks WHERE finishedAt IS NOT NULL AND model IS NOT NULL AND createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR agentId = ?) GROUP BY model ORDER BY tasks DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT model, COUNT(*) AS tasks, ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("finishedAt" - "createdAt"))) / 60)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS avg_minutes FROM agent_tasks WHERE "finishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND model IS NOT NULL AND "createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE("agentId", '') = $2) GROUP BY model ORDER BY tasks DESC

sqlite.sql: SELECT model, ROUND(SUM(durationMs) / 60000.0, 1) AS active_minutes, ROUND(SUM(totalCostUsd), 2) AS cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(totalCostUsd) / NULLIF(SUM(durationMs) / 60000.0, 0), 4) AS cost_per_minute FROM session_costs WHERE createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR agentId = ?) AND durationMs > 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_per_minute DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT model, ROUND((SUM("durationMs") / 60000.0)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS active_minutes, ROUND((SUM("totalCostUsd"))::numeric, 2)::float8 AS cost_usd, ROUND((SUM("totalCostUsd") / NULLIF(SUM("durationMs") / 60000.0, 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS cost_per_minute FROM session_costs WHERE "createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE("agentId", '') = $2) AND "durationMs" > 0 GROUP BY model ORDER BY cost_per_minute DESC NULLS LAST

sqlite.sql: SELECT COALESCE(a.name, sc.agentId, 'unknown') AS agent, ROUND(SUM(sc.durationMs) / 60000.0, 1) AS active_minutes, ROUND(SUM(sc.totalCostUsd), 2) AS cost_usd, ROUND(SUM(sc.totalCostUsd) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.durationMs) / 60000.0, 0), 4) AS cost_per_minute FROM session_costs sc LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = sc.agentId WHERE sc.createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR sc.agentId = ?) AND sc.durationMs > 0 GROUP BY agent ORDER BY cost_per_minute DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT COALESCE(a.name, sc."agentId", 'unknown') AS agent, ROUND((SUM(sc."durationMs") / 60000.0)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS active_minutes, ROUND((SUM(sc."totalCostUsd"))::numeric, 2)::float8 AS cost_usd, ROUND((SUM(sc."totalCostUsd") / NULLIF(SUM(sc."durationMs") / 60000.0, 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS cost_per_minute FROM session_costs sc LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = sc."agentId" WHERE sc."createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE(sc."agentId", '') = $2) AND sc."durationMs" > 0 GROUP BY agent ORDER BY cost_per_minute DESC NULLS LAST

sqlite.sql: SELECT COALESCE(a.name, t.agentId, 'unassigned') AS agent, COUNT(*) AS tasks, ROUND(AVG((julianday(t.finishedAt) - julianday(t.createdAt)) * 1440), 1) AS avg_minutes, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sc.cost), 0), 2) AS cost_usd, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sc.cost), 0) / COUNT(*), 4) AS avg_cost_per_task, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(sc.cost), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.dur) / 60000.0, 0), 4) AS cost_per_minute FROM agent_tasks t LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = t.agentId LEFT JOIN (SELECT taskId, SUM(totalCostUsd) AS cost, SUM(durationMs) AS dur FROM session_costs GROUP BY taskId) sc ON sc.taskId = t.id WHERE t.finishedAt IS NOT NULL AND t.createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = 'all' OR COALESCE(t.agentId, '') = ?) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY tasks DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT COALESCE(a.name, t."agentId", 'unassigned') AS agent, COUNT(*) AS tasks, ROUND((AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (t."finishedAt" - t."createdAt"))) / 60)::numeric, 1)::float8 AS avg_minutes, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(sc.cost), 0))::numeric, 2)::float8 AS cost_usd, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(sc.cost), 0) / COUNT(*))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS avg_cost_per_task, ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(sc.cost), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.dur) / 60000.0, 0))::numeric, 4)::float8 AS cost_per_minute FROM agent_tasks t LEFT JOIN agents a ON a.id = t."agentId" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "taskId", SUM("totalCostUsd") AS cost, SUM("durationMs") AS dur FROM session_costs GROUP BY "taskId") sc ON sc."taskId" = t.id WHERE t."finishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND t."createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval AND ($2 = 'all' OR COALESCE(t."agentId", '') = $2) GROUP BY agent ORDER BY tasks DESC

sqlite.sql: SELECT date(finishedAt) AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM agent_tasks WHERE finishedAt IS NOT NULL AND finishedAt >= datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

postgres.sql: SELECT to_char("finishedAt" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM agent_tasks WHERE "finishedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "finishedAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

sqlite.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) GROUP BY status ORDER BY tasks DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE "createdAt" >= statement_timestamp() + $1::interval GROUP BY status ORDER BY tasks DESC

sqlite.sql: SELECT id, label FROM (SELECT 'all' AS id, 'All requesters' AS label, 0 AS sort_key UNION ALL SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), email, id) AS label, 1 AS sort_key FROM users WHERE id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY sort_key, label COLLATE NOCASE

postgres.sql: SELECT id, label FROM (SELECT 'all' AS id, 'All requesters' AS label, 0 AS sort_key UNION ALL SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), email, id) AS label, 1 AS sort_key FROM users WHERE id IS NOT NULL) AS options ORDER BY sort_key, lower(label)

sqlite.sql: SELECT id, label FROM (SELECT 'all' AS id, 'All agents' AS label, 0 AS sort_key UNION ALL SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), id) AS label, 1 AS sort_key FROM agents WHERE id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY sort_key, label COLLATE NOCASE

postgres.sql: SELECT id, label FROM (SELECT 'all' AS id, 'All agents' AS label, 0 AS sort_key UNION ALL SELECT id, COALESCE(NULLIF(name, ''), id) AS label, 1 AS sort_key FROM agents WHERE id IS NOT NULL) AS options ORDER BY sort_key, lower(label)

ports.source: new-dashboard template widget task-statuses (before the portable template)

sqlite.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE createdAt >= datetime('now', ?) AND (? = '' OR COALESCE(requestedByUserId, '') = ?) AND (? = '' OR COALESCE(agentId, '') = ?) GROUP BY status ORDER BY tasks DESC

postgres.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS tasks FROM agent_tasks WHERE "createdAt" >= $1 AND ($2 = '' OR COALESCE("requestedByUserId", '') = $2) AND ($3 = '' OR COALESCE("agentId", '') = $3) GROUP BY status ORDER BY tasks DESC
